MATCH (o:Owner)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(d:Document), (o)-[r:Owns]->(t:Team)
WITH o, r,
  CASE
    WHEN o.birth_date IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE date_diff('year', strptime(o.birth_date, '%Y/%m/%d'), DATE '2026-10-14') -
      CASE WHEN strftime(strptime(o.birth_date, '%Y/%m/%d'), '%m-%d') > '10-14' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
  END AS owner_age
WHERE owner_age <= 76
   OR o.name = 'Joseph Chung-Hsin Tsai'
   OR CAST(r.since_year AS INT64) > 2013
   OR o.nationality = 'American'
RETURN r.since_year AS col1, owner_age AS col2, o.nationality AS col3, o.name AS name_manager

MATCH (o:Owner)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document), (o)-[r:Owns]->(:Team)
WITH o, r,
  CASE
    WHEN o.birth_date IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE 2026 - CAST(split_part(o.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64)
      - CASE
          WHEN CAST(split_part(o.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) > 10 THEN 1
          WHEN CAST(split_part(o.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) = 10
            AND CAST(split_part(o.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) > 14 THEN 1
          ELSE 0
        END
  END AS owner_age
WHERE owner_age <= 76
   OR o.name = 'Joseph Chung-Hsin Tsai'
   OR CAST(r.since_year AS INT64) > 2013
   OR o.nationality = 'American'
RETURN r.since_year AS col1, owner_age AS col2, o.nationality AS col3, o.name AS name_manager
